description: This file contains a test implementation of an `IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor` named `EventHubReceiverMonitorForTesting`, which tracks Call counters for various event hub receiver activities. It also defines a serializable class `EventHubReceiverMonitorCounters` that holds counters for different monitored methods.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorForTesting
classes.description: Test implementation of `IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor` that tracks calls via counters.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorCounters
classes.description: Serializable class that holds counters for the monitor's method calls.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Increments the initialization call counter if success is true.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Increments the read call counter if success is true.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Increments the shutdown call counter if success is true.
